questbrand.Brand tracking: Awareness, consideration and momentum, tracked every day. Not a quarterly report.
questbrand.Competitive benchmarking: Your numbers next to the competitors you name, in up to 24 markets.
questbrand.Campaign impact: See a campaign move the numbers while it is still running.
questbrand.Emotional drivers: What people feel about the brand, and how that changes over time.

questdiy.AI-drafted surveys: Say what you want to learn. The questionnaire is drafted for you to edit.
questdiy.Respondents in 100+ countries: A built-in panel fields the study in more than 100 countries.
questdiy.Concept & message testing: Put concepts, messages and ads in front of real people before launch.
questdiy.Same-day reads: Built, fielded and read in as little as four hours.

bera.Brand ROI tracking: Brand performance tied to pricing power and revenue. You can show which brand investments pay.
bera.Audience prioritization: Loyals, switchers, prospects and win-backs, and which of them are worth growing.
bera.Media planning: Ten years of history feed media mix modelling, with brand next to media, pricing and distribution.

knowledge_machine.Real-time sentiment across owned, earned: Your channels, earned coverage and competitors, read together as it happens.
knowledge_machine.Historical pattern matching against prio: Each new signal is matched to earlier moments that looked like it.
knowledge_machine.Full audience profile surfaced with the: Every signal comes with who is driving it.

unicepta.Global monitoring: 460M+ sources across news, social, broadcast and AI answers, in 187 languages.
unicepta.Daily briefings & alerts: A daily media review and real-time alerts, built around your brand.
unicepta.Narrative analysis: Analysts and AI read the narratives and risks behind the numbers.
unicepta.Social listening: Social conversation tracked next to media coverage.

imai.Creator discovery: Search 400M+ creators. Vet audiences and check for fraud before signing anyone.
imai.Campaign management: Outreach, contracts, approvals and results in one place.
imai.LLM visibility: How AI search tools talk about your brand, in the same platform.
imai.UGC video ads: AI-generated UGC-style video, made where you run creator campaigns.

smb_platform.Creator discovery: Find creators who fit your brand. No influencer team needed.
smb_platform.Audience validation: Check a creator's audience is real before you spend.
smb_platform.ROI tracking: See what each creator and campaign returned.
smb_platform.One dashboard: Listen, plan, run and measure from one place. Built for teams of 10 to 250.

geopulse.AI visibility intelligence: How ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity describe your brand, topic by topic, refreshed daily.
geopulse.Prompt optimization: Prompts written the way real people ask, by persona and journey.
geopulse.Competitive benchmarking: Where AI answers recommend a rival instead of you.
geopulse.Content simulation: Test a content change and see how it shifts what AI says.

numetrix.Audience measurement: Who actually saw and visited, from verified visitation data.
numetrix.Brand lift & ad impact: Impressions connected to brand lift, so OOH can be judged next to CTV and TV.
numetrix.Location intelligence: Foot traffic and dwell time, and whether advertising changed where people went.

media_machine.Scores every platform and channel agains: Every channel is scored on evidence of what has worked.
media_machine.Drafts the plan and flighting: The media plan and flighting, drafted for your team to adjust.
media_machine.Models spend and projected lift: Spend scenarios and the lift each one should deliver.

newintel.Pricing moves: Competitor price changes, as they happen.
newintel.Hiring signals: New roles show where a competitor is investing.
newintel.Earned coverage: What the press says about your competitors, week by week.
newintel.Creator activity: Which creators your competitors work with, and what they post.

search_plus.AI search representation: How your brand is described inside AI search today, and where it falls short.
search_plus.Influence how AI recommends you: Shape the content AI tools draw on, so they recommend you more often.
search_plus.ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok: One program across the assistants people ask first.

id_graph.First-party data onboarding: Match your customer data to 260 million US consumers and 123 million households.
id_graph.Third-party media data: Media data from partners joins the same identity spine.
id_graph.Proprietary consumer intelligence: Stagwell data from BERA, the Harris Poll and Numetrix.
id_graph.Privacy-safe activation: Build and activate audiences without exposing anyone's identity.
